details: Crypto tracker Whale Alert reported approximately $2 billion in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins left Binance within three hours of the exchange reopening withdrawals on November 1, 2026. Binance had frozen withdrawals after a $6.3 billion hack on October 29. The exchange stated it has replaced around 95% of the stolen assets and is now processing withdrawals from newly generated wallets. While a "Sunday pump" was anticipated by some, Bitcoin saw only a modest 1.05% uptick in 24 hours, trading below its pre-hack level. Investors also pulled $643 million from Bitcoin ETFs the day after the hack.
title: Binance Sees $2 Billion Outflow as Withdrawals Resume Post-Hack

details: Solana's price was trading near $95.5 on November 1, 2026, struggling after a bruising October that saw its value drop by almost a fifth. The token is facing pressure from four consecutive days of net redemptions from U.S. spot Solana exchange-traded products, totaling roughly $60.73 million. Additionally, the broader market sentiment is being weighed down by the recent Binance security breach, estimated at $6.3 billion and linked to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.
title: Solana Under Pressure from ETF Redemptions and Binance Breach

details: The Moscow Exchange is set to begin trading Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT stablecoins on December 1, 2026, under new Russian cryptocurrency regulations. This development signals increased institutional adoption and integration of cryptocurrencies into traditional financial markets in Russia.
title: Moscow Exchange to Launch Crypto Trading in December
